firstPlayerRule: After everyone simultaneously melds one of their two starting Age 1 cards, the player whose melded card title comes first alphabetically takes the first turn.
clarifications: The first player takes only one action on their initial turn. In a game with four or more players, the first two players take only one action on their initial turns.
